steps.name: The road to the Eastern Continent
steps.objective: Talk to [Durun] at the "Recapture Army Temporary Station" and go to [Rosemary] in the "Eastern Border of Jude Kingdom" on the Eastern Continent.

steps.name: Shall we take a look at your skills?
steps.objective: After talking with [Rosemary], go to the capital of Jude Kingdom and kill [Desert Fox Assassin] and [Heat Wave Genie].

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I've never seen this guy before, who are you? Reveal your identity. otherwise… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let your guard down. I was introduced by Leo at the Temple of Ceres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Rosemary? You came all this way to escort Iris... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You understand well, right? Yes, I am Rosemary... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait you… , Looking at his clothes, could it be him? Iris said… . Let’s start by telling the story of how you got here. So that I can understand properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Rosemary everything that has happened so far. From the beginning of the trip to what recently happened at the Temple of Ceres.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I can't believe it. You mean you defeated Blas, the leader of the demon unit that attacked the temple? That's why you came here through Leo... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's all purely to meet Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Where is Iris?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait. I can't trust you now. I can't let you meet Iris right away.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I am not so gentle as to trust someone I meet for the first time.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I will still help you, but you will have to work with me. It might be a bit annoying.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Iris I arrived at Eastland with you, but something came up. As soon as I got here, what was this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: In the center of Eastland, there is a place called Lu Man. Luman fights against the evil that is disturbing Eastland in the name of the Union of Light.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's pretty complicated here too. There are more than one opponent to fight with.  Anyway, the leader of the place, a man named Giscard, known as the ‘Sword God’, has a connection with Demigod Frozen.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Frozen decided that if Iris went there, she would be able to more reliably accept the power she received from Ceres under the protection of the Sword God.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: They say there is a place in Luman where special people can practice... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, anyway, we were getting ready to head to Luman. But with amazing timing, someone attacked Jude Kingdom and the road was cut off.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: First of all, Iris couldn't be here, so Frozen went first. I'm staying here and looking at the situation.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's annoying. I knew it wasn't easy, but I didn't know why I was doing this. It would be very difficult for us to deal with the demonic beings that are chasing you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Frozen, no, Frozen, how did I survive because of that person... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The story got longer, huh? Iris If it's for you, please help me with my work. If the Kingdom of Jude falls, Luman, where Iris will be, is also in danger.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: First, I need to see your skills. You know what to do, right?

steps.name: please help me
steps.objective: After talking with [Rosemary], go to the capital of Jude Kingdom and kill [Mad Sand Spirit] and [Agni Warrior].

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's more surprising than it looks. I didn't know that enemies could be dealt with so easily. I thought it wasn't just Adventurer, but I never thought it would be like this.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: First of all, I passed, and I think I'm qualified to protect Iris.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then let’s move on to the next task in earnest.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: There are many ethnic minority villages near the Judean Kingdom. Among them, there is a clan whose ancestor is the sun god Agni. Their name is Agni.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agni clan?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Originally, they lived as mercenaries in the desert as a separate force from the Kingdom of Jude. I understand that the chieftain of the Agni clan is also close to His Majesty the King of Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: At some point, I took my clan and attacked the Kingdom of Jude. Moreover, it is the Kingdom of Moss... . Ah, this is complicated. How much do I have to explain... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The Kingdom of Moss was a kingdom in Freios a long time ago, but somehow it was defeated and ended up in Eastland. I wonder if they are acting at the instigation of the Mosse Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Anyway, Chief Agni led his troops into Merta, the capital of the Kingdom of Jude, and created a mess. Then it disappeared somewhere, and I don't know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: For now, I'm looking for it separately. Please help me too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I don't know where he might be, but I need to find him and deal with him first. There's nothing you can do about it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That person is a strong enemy. It won't be easy since he is the one at the center of the battle mercenary Agni.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I want to chase after him and fight, but I have to protect this place. The people of Jude Kingdom have come all the way down to the border area, so we are short of hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there other enemies besides the Agni clan?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Iris You know that there are more than one person chasing you, right? Probably a demon.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Come to your senses. This is a battlefield. If you don't focus, you don't know what will happen.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Anyway, let's go quickly and find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it all over once you find the enemy?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Let's hope it's over, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Huh, anyway, it's frustrating to see what the Jude Kingdom's guards are doing. We need to evacuate the residents, so let's take out the enemies in front of us first.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: There's a lot to do, hehe... . I thought it would get a little easier once I became a battle lord... .

steps.name: Let’s end this war quickly.
steps.objective: After talking with [Rosemary], go to [Hyssop] in the capital of Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Okay. Very neat. I definitely feel like I have experience.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Your skills in dealing with enemies are extraordinary. Phew.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Iris I can trust you, but there's still a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now we can go find the enemy commander, right?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Don't rush. What are you going to do if you go ahead and do something wrong? There has to be information.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: There must be someone called Hyssop. He is a man who trembles like a coward, but he has information. Even though he seems incompetent, he holds his position because of his intelligence.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Go to that human and ask if he has any information about the enemy commander.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm a little worried about whether I should treat him well in this situation just because he's the guard captain. I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: He's probably blaming himself for not being able to properly protect his capital, so treat him appropriately. But don't stay too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will keep this in mind.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: If they doubt you, tell them I sent you. otherwise… . They say they will spread the secret of hyssop. That's enough.  Even if you do that, it will move.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: What's wrong with your expression? Like looking at some kind of bad person... . Yes, I know it well. This method isn't particularly good, but... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's a method I had no choice but to learn in order to survive. Don't worry about it, it's not important right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Come on, we don't have time. Because I'd be doing something else!

steps.name: The story of the Khaim chieftain
steps.objective: After talking to [Hyssop], defeat [Darman] in the "Palace of the Sun", talk to [Darman], and then report to [Hyssop].

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your skills in defeating enemies are unusual. Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, don't be surprised. I came here because Rosemary sent me. so… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing that Hyssop is not letting down his guard, I try to persuade him once again.)

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Someone who is questionable as friend or foe comes here and mentions Rosemary's name, so we have no choice but to be wary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are still suspicious. Rosemary said the secret of hyssop is... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: … Let’s stop there. I believe it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what's going on. So you can rest assured.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I'll believe you're an ally, so you don't have to say anything more.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Then I will tell you. It would be a good idea to take a look inside the palace first.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Ugh... You... . Who are you? Who is it that has this power? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Now, wait… . Are you talking?

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Now, listen carefully... . I won't be able to hold out for long because the souls of Ancient Ents are mixed together. The reason I am awake now is because of your strength.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: So I'll tell you what you want to know. I am the chief of the Kaim tribe. It’s different… .

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: I don't have time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, what was the reason for invading Jude Kingdom? I don't know why the Agni clan, who had been living without any problems with the Kingdom of Jude, invaded, but what about the Kaim clan... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't understand. Was this at the instigation of the Morse Kingdom?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is going on here?

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: It would be better if our will attacked Jude Kingdom. Because there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: However, they took the helpless and weak children of the clan hostage and threatened them. And they forced me to fight.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Every time we reject them, they… . Our children... .

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: They did this because they knew brainwashing wouldn't work on us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, me. then. What happened to the people who were taken hostage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: You're going to die. This happened because I lacked virtue and will... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this… . This is too much. I guess.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: It's not your fault. Don't blame yourself. Those with red hair are the culprits... . They have human appearance, but they are not human.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Those who brought disaster to the desert came to Eastland and joined hands with the Kingdom of Morse. The Kingdom of Mos must have something they want, so they must have accepted them.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: There is something they are trying to gain by starting this war. So please stop it. Chief Agni was also taken advantage of. I'm not asking you to forgive him.

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: Stop them. There can be no more bloodshed in Eastland. Everyone already has an enemy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they had red hair, would they be Ban and Mara?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And…

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: I'm out of my mind... . It feels distant. I can't hear your story... .

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: To Agni before my soul falls asleep... Please tell this to the residents of Jude Kingdom... . I said I was sorry... … .

lines.speaker: 다르만
lines.text: (Darman’s voice can no longer be heard.)

steps.name: solid information
steps.objective: After talking with [Hyssop], go to [Balas] near the entrance to the “Underground Altar of the Sun God”.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You've been there. What is the inside of the palace like?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Hyssop the story that happened in the palace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Chaim… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The two people who are the main culprits of the Kingdom of Mos took Darman's family hostage and threatened them... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: This is not the time to get lost in sentimentality. Even if they had circumstances, they were enemies to us... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: They attacked us and we suffered great damage. That's true. true… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because that just happened... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You still care.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chief Agni could not be found there. Do you know where it went? Do you have any information?

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: You're in a hurry. Just calm down for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: According to the soldiers, he headed towards the underground altar of the sun god. Your Majesty must be there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. You can't be like this now.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: We hurriedly sent soldiers to where Balas, the guard of the Underground Altar Palace, was. Let's hurry up and take a look there.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: If you go to him you will get more information. You should listen to the whole story over there... .

steps.name: The leader of the enemy army is... .
steps.objective: After talking to [Balas], enter the “Underground Altar of the Sun God”, kill [35th Agni], and talk to [King Jude].

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Do you? Oh, Rosemary’s group? I heard this from the soldiers who arrived first.

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: My name is Balas, a palace guard. i look forward to.

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Now we are preparing to enter here. However, it’s complicated so it might take a bit longer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you hesitating because it takes a long time? No, before that, a person called the palace guard said something like that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped that we were attacked, but it doesn't suit the current situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A subject who does not even know the life or death of His Majesty the King, the lord of a country... .

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: … There is no shame. It happened because I was weak. So please blame me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't say that to me, a third party. It is for His Majesty to decide... . I am… . Phew, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t want to think about this, but why are all the characters in the Jude Kingdom like this? Let’s go in and find Chief Agni.)

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I have nothing to say. Take my head like this and bring it to the Jude Kingdom army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's strange. Why are you so resigned? As if I had hoped for this situation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chief Darman of the Kaim tribe said this. He said he was sorry for attacking him.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Ah… . I see. That's it. I guessed it would be like that, but... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. Hey, wait a moment. I have something to say to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Yes, I am the king of Jude Kingdom... . I'm fine, so you don't have to worry. I'm sorry this is my first time meeting you, but please step aside for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you again... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: (The King of Jude Kingdom looks at the fallen Chief Agni.)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: It's been a while, friend. Your eyes are still cold. Isn’t it time to loosen things up a bit?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Not only because he still doesn't take jokes, but also because of his skills. It reminds me of a time a long time ago when we were together through a difficult time.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You, who received the power of the sun god Agni, were truly amazing.  Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Hahaha... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Please at least say one word. Am I the only one talking?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Why on earth are you on the side of the Morse Kingdom? Why did you attack our kingdom? It wasn't like this before.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Also, why did you leave me alone instead of killing me? From your perspective now, I am your enemy.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: There must be a reason for leaving the enemy alone without killing him. Hey, tell me what's happening in this desert. Please tell me what's going on.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Only then can I keep my promise to you.

steps.name: Good news 1
steps.objective: After talking with [King Jude], “Go to [Balas] near the entrance to the Sun God’s Underground Altar.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Please tell me quickly because I want to protect what I decided to do for your clan during your difficult times.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Okay, let me tell you. Some people came to the Morse Kingdom. They showed the magic stone to the king and prince of the Morse Kingdom and brainwashed the soldiers there.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: So the Morse Kingdom soldiers appeared and oppressed the desert minorities, and in the process, many magic stones spread.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Minorities and spirits were brainwashed and started attacking us, and we tried to hold out as best as we could. However, they were unable to handle their numbers and were defeated.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: The Kaim clan and our clan had no choice but to enter the Jude Kingdom to avoid death... .

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I thought I had achieved the pride of the Agni clan with my own hands, but I ruined it all... .  Even the sun god won't forgive... .

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: The continent has become like this only because of red-haired twin siblings... .

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Listen carefully, the Morse Kingdom will gradually increase its power.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: By increasing the number of magic stones, we will swallow up even this Eastland!! The Deimos Church may be looking for this moment!!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. Leave the rest to me. Because I will do well in anything. Trust me.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Now, I will tell you what to do with you.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Stay in prison for a while and reflect on yourself.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: What are you talking about now? Are you going to save me? I'm dying. Of course it is a body that must die.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Otherwise, the residents of Jude Kingdom will not forgive you.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I won't allow that.

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: Only when I die can the hostages held in the Morse Kingdom live.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: … Do you believe that? Don't believe it. Do you think King Boyd and Prince Nox of the Morth Kingdom are people who will show mercy?

lines.speaker: 35대 아그니
lines.text: I'll leave it to you.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Yeah, good idea. I'll think about the best way.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Well, now my story is over. Thanks for your time. Now let me go back and report this situation. The attacks on ethnic minorities have come to an end... .

steps.name: Good news 2
steps.objective: After talking with [Balas], go to [Lord Basil] in the “eastern border of Jude Kingdom.”

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Your Majesty, are you okay? Balas, I wish for Your Majesty’s well-being… .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Be quiet, be quiet. I was wondering where you've been, but it's nice to see you here.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Hey, are you hurt anywhere? Somehow, my face seems to have gotten better over the years. haha… .

lines.speaker: 발라스
lines.text: Well, Your Majesty's safety is more important than mine... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: How many times have you said it's okay? By the way, where is the hyssop?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Could it be that he died in battle? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. It's coming.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I see. I need to meet Hyssop and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your Majesty, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: It was fine until a little while ago... , I'm tired after seeing you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: Your Majesty, I have committed a mortal sin. The crime of failing to properly fulfill my mission and protect His Majesty even though I was a guard captain... .

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: The sin of not being able to fight back against the enemy's attack and falling down is all my fault.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I, I… .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Stop it. Okay, now stand up. If you say one more word, I might get angry at you, so stop!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: (Hyssop, who heard the king's story, then stands up and retreats.)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I'm sure you all have learned something from this situation. Now you have a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You probably know that this happened to us in Luman too. The enemy's leader has been defeated, but there are still remnants left, so I will send someone.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: For now, I hope that you will not respond to the enemy's provocations, but rather use your military in a way that will hold out as much as possible. The Union of Light would also like that... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: I will go with this Adventurer to the border area of Pesto and work out a plan with Lord Basil. So, you guys, follow my lead here.

lines.speaker: 히솝
lines.text: I will follow Your Majesty’s orders!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can we really trust those people? Hehe, let’s take His Majesty to the border area….)

steps.name: Let's go. To Lu Man.
steps.objective: After talking to [Lord Basil], talk to [Rosemary].

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty! your majesty!!

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Oh! Basil, my friend! How are you? It's nice to see you again after a long time.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: You're safe! I'm so glad! Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: I heard that there was Adventurer heading there to save His Majesty... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Yes, I survived thanks to this friend. He had amazing skills. I feel like I want to use every means possible to hold on... .

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: That must be my greed. Phew… . What should I do if I blame myself for not having a good fortune?

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: This guy seems to have work to do, as he talks to church members from far away.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty… .

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Next time, we will make sure that the right talent goes to Your Majesty's side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Haha, it's okay. If I didn't do well this time, couldn't I just do better next time? Thanks to you, we can protect this country.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: You are the benefactor of this country... . I will let future generations know and praise your merits.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Just like a long time ago when Jiscard, the Sword God, saved everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I didn't do anything that big... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now you can hear about Iris….)

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Thank you. I hope we meet again on better occasions next time.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: We will find a better way on our own, and we will ensure that the residents are not harmed.

lines.speaker: 쥬드 왕국 국왕
lines.text: Now that the Kingdom of Morse has gained new power, I don't think it will give up easily... . I will continue to use it to create great things.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Your Majesty… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just leave now. See you next time then.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Thank goodness. Seeing you come back like this... . I thought it wouldn't be too much of a problem, but... . Well, anyway, tell me how it ended.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Rosemary the story of meeting Chief Agni. And so on.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah? Those guys called Agashura joined forces with the Kingdom of Mos and took advantage of the Kaim and Agni clans?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Something strange.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Agashura is creating demons and providing them to the kingdom... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The Moss Kingdom was originally a country that had been struggling to gain hegemony since it was in Freios, and if they were kicked out and came here and did the same thing, it would be understandable.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The problem is those guys. The one who gave the magic stone to the Morse Kingdom... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Agashura guys... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I know that they are destined to do evil and cause chaos... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Their actions are different. I just feel like I'm doing something personal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah... . Can't you feel it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Phew, I don't know the details. By the way, now that we're done here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What the hell is Agash….)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Now go solve your purpose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Now I have to go see Iris. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hehe, your expression is finally brightening. Even if I don't like it a little, I can't help it. Because it is a promise to the church.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I received news that Iris arrived safely in Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… . Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck, Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like the stuffy feeling in my heart is flying away... I am...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are not many days left until we can meet.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Okay, first of all, I have some more work to do here, so I can't come with you. So you go straight to Luman.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Lu Man can be reached through White Coal Canyon in the north of Jude Kingdom. and… .
